literal: On xinmao day Han Derang was concurrently made Chief Councillor.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Han Derang was also appointed Chief Councillor.

literal: On guisi day the sale in markets of cloth and silk that failed to meet standard measures was forbidden.
idiomatic: On guisi day the court forbade the sale in markets of cloth and silk that did not meet standard dimensions.

literal: On bingshen day, on the eastern expedition against the Jurchen, supreme commanders Xiao Talan and Pusa Nu presented the distances and local products along the army's route.
idiomatic: On bingshen day, during the eastern campaign against the Jurchen, supreme commanders Xiao Talan and Pusa Nu submitted reports on distances along the march route and on local products.
